ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry to hear about your grill flaring up. We are happy to help. 

Flare ups are a byproduct of grilling over live fire. The drippings falling down create the flare ups. While they can never be eliminated completely, below are some steps for reducing them:

1. Cleaning your grill. We recommend cleaning your cooking grates, Flavorizer bars, burner tubes, heat deflectors (if applicable), the inside of your cookbox, and your slide out grease tray.

2. If using a marinade, get as much excess liquid off as possible before putting the food on the grill.

3. If using a sauce, wait until the last 5-10 minutes to apply.

Our Care team is following up with you. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: This was not my first Weber Grill.  In fact this is the third Weber Grill that I have purchased in this century.  The two previous Grills were both Natural Gas and one replaced the other after almost 20 years of service.  Well we down sized our home and left the newest one for the new owner of the home.  It was only a year or so old and it was a delight to cook on.  Well we finally made the decision to get a grill for our Florida home and there was no choice but to get a new Weber Grill.  We have only had it for about two weeks now and we started cooking on it the 2nd night.  So far we have used it for Shrimp, Fish, Steaks, Kabobs, Hot Dogs and tonight Kielbasa.  Each one was a hit and we look forward to using it often.

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a Weber Spirit E-210 grill.  It’s my second (the first lasted about 3 times as long as cheaper brands), and I’m quite happy with it.  I especially like its small footprint and the quality of the grill which translates to reliable good grilling for many years.  It’s clearly the best “bang for your buck” small grill.   Having said that, it’s not perfect.  My purchase was missing a small part (which Weber quickly sent me) and the door beneath the grill has got some denting (which I decided was just an aesthetic issue and not worth contacting Weber about).  But even with that, the grill was clearly my best choice, and I look forward to many years of grilling with it.
Results.Title: Best choice if you want a small grill you can use
